**

Mayer in Tirol

** **

Welcome to Mayer in Tirol – where tradition meets modern comfort in the heart of the Alps.

** **

Authentic Tyrolean Hospitality

** **

Since 1923, Mayer has been a beloved name in Tirol. Our family-run guesthouse in the charming village of Innsbruck offers a warm welcome, hearty Tyrolean cuisine, and cozy rooms with a view of the Nordkette. Whether you're here for skiing, hiking, or simply relaxing, we promise an unforgettable stay.

** **

Our Signature Dishes

** **

Indulge in our famous Kaiserschmarrn, a fluffy pancake torn into pieces and served with powdered sugar and apricot jam. For meat lovers, our Tiroler Gröstl—a hearty potato and bacon hash—is a must-try. Pair your meal with a glass of local Apfelstrudel or a cold Zirbenschnaps for the full Alpine experience.

** **

Adventure Awaits

** **

Just steps from our door, explore the stunning Alpenzoo Innsbruck, take the cable car up to the Hafelekar, or set off on a hike through the Karwendel mountains. In winter, the Nordkette Ski Area is right at your fingertips.

** **

Why Choose Us?

** **
  • Central location – Easy access to Innsbruck's city center and nature.
  • Family atmosphere – Personal service with a smile.
  • Authentic Tyrolean charm – Wooden beams, alpine decor, and cozy fires.
  • Affordable luxury – High-quality comfort without the high prices.
** **

Book Your Stay

** **

Reserve your room at Mayer in Tirol today and experience the best of Tirol’s hospitality. We look forward to welcoming you!
